works.title: Caesar
works.author: C. Iulius Caesar
works.label: Gallic War
works.note: Of the Gallic War the treebank annotates twelve chapters of Book 2; the chapters it skips are simply absent.

works.title: Cicero
works.author: M. Tullius Cicero
works.label: Against Catiline
works.note: Numbered by chapter, the unit the annotators recorded, not by the finer section numbers also used to cite these speeches. The First Catilinarian is complete; the Second breaks off in chapter 11, and chapter 9 was never annotated.

works.title: Tacitus
works.author: Cornelius Tacitus
works.label: Histories
works.note: The treebank records no chapter or section numbers for this text, so it is numbered by sentence. Upstream the file is filed under Tacitus's Annals; its text is in fact the opening of the Histories.
